title: arnebia ugamensis
intro: Arnebia ugamensis, commonly known as Khorma, is a flowering plant in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is used in traditional medicine and has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in the treatment of conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of Arnebia ugamensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, kill bacteria, and exhibit antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
